title: Energy Performance Certificates
text: An Energy Performance Certificate rates a property's energy efficiency and lists recommended improvements with indicative costs and savings.

title: Warm Homes: Local Grant
text: Eligible lower-income households may receive funded energy-efficiency measures through participating local authorities. Eligibility and availability depend on household and property criteria.

title: Boiler Upgrade Scheme
text: The Boiler Upgrade Scheme provides grants toward eligible low-carbon heating systems in England and Wales. Installers apply on behalf of property owners.

title: Ofgem Energy Advice
text: Ofgem publishes household energy guidance, consumer protections and routes to support. Advice should be checked against current eligibility rules before a decision.
